Summer Analyst Internship 2027

Job description

Ada & Co is hiring Summer Analysts for its London operations team in 2027. As a Summer Analyst you will reconcile trades, investigate breaks with traders and engineers, and build small tools in Python and SQL that make the team's daily checks faster and more reliable. You will work alongside experienced analysts on real problems from your first week, present what you built at the end of the summer, and learn how a trading firm keeps its books accurate.

We are looking for students graduating in 2027 or 2028 with strong analytical skills, attention to detail and clear written communication. Experience with Python or SQL is helpful but not required. The internship runs for ten weeks from June 2027 in London.
